reports.title: EIP-4337 – Ethereum Account Abstraction Audit
reports.description: OpenZeppelin's first audit, commissioned by the Ethereum Foundation, of the EIP-4337 reference implementation: the EntryPoint/StakeManager core singleton and the sample wallets and paymasters in the account-abstraction repository. The EIP and architectural design were also reviewed, and the fixes were verified in a final commit.
